arguments.description: Render one shot's frame set through Remotion (default) or, when explicitly requested with tool:blender_render, through Blender, from the shot's key plates and pose chart (D72, D83): the puppet holds and plays authored breakdowns between keys and never redraws; writes the stills, the consecutive-frame strip, the figure-only sequence and joints dump the inbetween probe reads, the identity probes, and the receipt skeleton.
